sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying a transformation to an absent value silently propagates Nothing without ever executing the function.
A variable that is moved (ownership transferred) can never be used again — the compiler enforces that the original binding is dead after the move.
A LEFT JOIN where the right table has no matching rows produces NULL in every column of the absent side — the structure of presence reveals the shape of what's missing.
